verdict.rationale: Orb publishes a structured API reference with per-endpoint pages (e.g., create customer alert) and pages on errors, pagination, idempotency, and cached responses, plus SDKs in six languages, so a reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or has runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive "try it" console or playground, runnable request examples, a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
